newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler worldwide Sept production rises.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler worldwide Sept production rises.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Friday it produced 246,213 cars and trucks at its worldwide plants in September, a 13 percent increase from 217,963 in September of 1995.
Worldwide production for the first nine months of 1996 is up nearly 20 percent to 2,149,394 from 1,193,994 for the 1995 period, Chrysler said.
September total vehicle production from U.S. and Canadian plants, which account for most of the automaker's production, rose to 207,505 from 198,960 in the year-ago month.
The U.S. No. 3 automaker produced a total of 168,774 trucks during the month, versus 145,999, and 77,439 cars, an increase from 71,964.
Chrysler did not revise its fourth quarter production numbers in its production release Friday.
